summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its annual report (equivalent to Form 20-F) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The filing includes standard sections on business overview, financial condition, risk factors, corporate governance, and financial statements. There is no event constituting a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The report is a routine annual disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no mention of any transaction, board recommendation, or structural change that would warrant classification under special-situations categories. Consequently, this filing is not a special situation.
